t_advice_summary_textbox.text: to switch decisions when the score starts reducing, certain gnomes are linked to different baskets, just to keep switching as score goes down

vb_textbox.text: If you pick the red, purple, pink or dark brown gnome they link to the red basket, these combinations seemed to give more points, The green, blue, yellow and orange gnomes result in the yellow basket.I found that the x5 is best played with a gnome that results in the red basket, I got my highest amount of mushrooms with that combo
